texts.preamble: Tummalapenta Naga Pravallika vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 22 June, 2022 Author: Ninala Jayasurya Bench: Ninala Jayasurya Hon'Ble Sri Justice Ninala Jayasurya Criminal Petition No.4272 Of 2022 Between:- Tummalapenta Naga Pravallika, W/o.Pradeep Kumar and another ...
texts.arguments: The learned counsel for the petitioners inter alia submits that in so far as the said Crime is concerned, the same was [LEAKAGE_MASK] by order dated 15.6.2022 in Criminal Petition No.4049 of 2022. He further submits that despite quashing of the Crime, the Police have not returned the seized property i.e., tobacco products and under the said circumstances, the petitioners are constrained to file the present Criminal Petition. The learned counsel also submits that in similar circumstances a learned Judge in Criminal Petition No.4087 of 2020, dated 24.9.2020 directed release of the seized tobacco products considering the fact that the crime registered against the petitioner therein was [LEAKAGE_MASK]. In view of the said position, learned counsel submits that the present Criminal Petition deserves to be allowed.
